derivation: from H3034 (יָדָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); praised of Jah;
def: Jedajah, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
